summary: Pre-existing fork gap (B97 batch C). Added the 16 spec builtins plus mulfuRN (GAP9 GCC has it; created by the mul_mac_N_RN multiclass). mulf*/macf* are exact aliases of mul*/mac* (same instructions and Sema checks); mul64h* select M mulh/mulhu/mulhsu (mul64hus swaps operands: signed y in rs1, as GCC); trunch/truncb are a plain truncate (p.exths / p.extbz / sh / sb at the use). No clang CodeGen edit. GCC defects (B98): macfs/macfu GCC output does not assemble -> clang emits p.macs/p.macu rd(acc),rs1,rs2; mulfsN N=32/-1 GCC ICE -> clang range error [0,31]; NEW: macfsRN(a,b,c,0,1) also ICEs GCC; mulfsRN ignores R in GCC (and GCC's own mulsRN rejects bad R and N=0) -> clang applies the existing mulsRN check to both spellings.
